title: Gold Leaf Mix Solo 2-Color #28 (세로 띠·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, silver-white locs cascading to her waist — her body is covered in applied metallic leaf in 2 different colours at once, each colour claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 2 vertical bands by 1 hazy transition zone centred about 71% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries applied RUBY RED metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright RUBY RED sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is everything to her right of the first transition zone: it carries applied SAPPHIRE BLUE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright SAPPHIRE BLUE sheen filling every gap. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring leaf colours dissolve into each other, flakes from one thinning out as flakes from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one colour, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots covered in the same leaf colours at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every leaf sheet and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
